summary: Frontend-only test of simplified message-delete UX in chat screen ((tabs)/messages/[userId].tsx). All 8 requested flows PASS. The ellipsis msg-action-* button is fully removed. Tap on own bubble now opens the themed confirm modal DIRECTLY (icon trash + title 'Elimina messaggio' + ANNULLA/CONFERMA buttons) — the react emoji sheet no longer opens for own messages. Cancel dismisses cleanly; Confirm marks the message as 'Messaggio eliminato'. Received-message behaviour is unchanged (simple tap = no-op for text, long-press opens react emoji sheet). Layout regression check: own bubbles right-aligned, received left-aligned, timestamp visible. Scroll persistence on new send confirmed (list stays at bottom, chat-scroll-latest opacity=0, latest DOM bubble matches just-sent message). No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: handleTap / handleLongPress logic in [userId].tsx (~L514-534) correctly gates on `mine` and short-circuits before opening react sheet for own bubbles.
confirmDialog modal (~L1010-1045) uses testIDs confirm-cancel / confirm-ok and correct button labels ANNULLA / CONFERMA — matches spec.
bubbleRow style (L1070) is a column layout again (only padding+margin), rowMine=flex-end, rowTheirs=flex-start — alignment restored as requested.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded users chat_a@test.it and chat_b@test.it (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Note: frontend uses Firebase login while these accounts exist only in the backend DB, so the login form returns 400. Workaround for testing: inject the backend-issued JWT into localStorage under key 'faide_token' (JSON-stringified) then reload — the app's refreshMe() hydrates the session via /api/auth/me. This is the same mechanism documented in test_credentials.md for the owner-only /admin flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To login as chat_a/chat_b via the UI, POST /api/auth/login and inject the returned token into localStorage as JSON.stringify(token) under key 'faide_token', then reload. The auth.tsx submit path uses Firebase and will 400 for these seeded backend-only accounts.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification of a UX simplification; no bug to root-cause.
